title: Arbitrary affine-space isomorphisms act trivially on the top trace source
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pur-affine-space-iso-trace-invariance, the compact-support action affineLinearTraceAction attached to any isomorphism of the affine coordinate tower over its base is the identity endomorphism of the affine trace source.

source.place: paragraph 2, geometric fibre degree-one calculation before applying the affine counit

proof.text: On a geometric stalk over a separably closed field, use the normalized projective-line Kummer class and the open-closed sequence to identify each rational point of affine one-space with the generator sent to one. The ordered coordinate induction identifies the top compact-support group with the rank-one coefficient module and shows that point classes generate it.

An arbitrary affine-space isomorphism carries each rational point to its unique inverse image, and the corresponding reduced closed subscheme has local cycle multiplicity one. Naturality of point classes and the canonical Tate comparison therefore fix the normalized generator. Hence the action is the identity on every geometric stalk, including dimension zero.

Compact-support base change identifies the specified derived action with the stalk action. Degree-zero faithfulness and conservativity of geometric stalks lift stalkwise identity to the derived source. Empty bases and the zero coefficient ring reduce to identity or zero-object equations.

theorem affineSpaceIsoTraceAction_eq_id (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ)
    (e : affineTraceTower S d ≅ affineTraceTower S d)
    (sq : IsPullback e.hom (affineTraceProjection S d)
      (affineTraceProjection S d) (𝟙 S)) :
    affineLinearTraceAction N hN A hA t S hS d e.hom sq = 𝟙 _
